description.value: Browns Socialhouse McCallum is a full-service chain restaurant and social bar located near the University of the Fraser Valley in Abbotsford, positioned as a neighbourhood gathering spot. The location offers sit-down dining, a full menu with delivery and pickup options, and free Wi-Fi. It is part of a large BC and Alberta chain operating under the Browns Restaurant Group.
